subject: Contract origination: party grid, template variance & initial redline log
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novumhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novum Health Legal <legal@novumhealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Initial MSA & parties for onboarding

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers. We're ready to start contracting. Attaching the MSA draft Novum typically uses and a party roster. A few callouts up front:

- We need an explicit data residency clause for PHI (US-only hosting).
- We generally require a 60-day data deletion window after contract termination.
- Master Services Agreement uses our standard indemnity language; legal may want to see Redwood's counterproposal.

Can you confirm who you'll loop in from your legal/ops side and share an initial timeline for redlines? We're trying to align procurement and security for an internal review next Thursday.

Attachments: Novum_MSA_Draft_V2_redline.docx (docx), party_grid_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
Novum Health

Date: 2027-02-20T10:01:00-08:00

Ellen — thanks, we appreciate the clarity. Quick answers:

- I'll coordinate legal redlines and an evidence packet.
- Kimberly (Contracts) + Jonas (Security) are copied to validate residency and evidence expectations.
- Proposed timeline: preliminary redlines and a list of open items by end of day Tuesday (2027-02-22), then a sync with your legal on Wednesday if that works.

Kimberly — can you review the party grid and Novum's indemnity language, and flag any required template exceptions? Jonas — can you confirm which pieces of the evidence matrix we can populate immediately vs. items needing security engineering input.

I'll add a brief exception log once we have Kimberly's read.

Best,
Rafael
Director, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novumhealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MSA & parties for onboarding

Thanks Rafael — I pulled the MSA and party grid. First-pass notes below; I'll produce a redline summary doc by Tuesday EOD.

High-level items:
- Indemnity: Novum's draft uses reciprocal broad indemnities with third-party claims language tied to PHI processing. Our standard template narrows scope; expect a counterproposal.
- Data deletion / retention: 60-day purge for PHI post-termination is non-standard for us; propose 90 days operationally but can agree to a 60-day certified-delete process if we can scope export/handback obligations.
- Data residency: we can commit to US-only regions (AWS GovCloud could be discussed), but need to confirm the account tier and whether Dedicated or Private deployment is required.
- Insurance: Novum requests a $5M cyber policy; our standard is $3M — will escalate if they push.

Attachments to follow from me: party_grid_review.xlsx (summary comments), exception_log_initial.md (short list), and a baseline redline summary.

Kimberly Park
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference

---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novumhealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-21T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MSA & parties for onboarding

Ellen / team — quick security read:

- Evidence matrix: I've populated the attached security_evidence_matrix.csv with what we can deliver immediately (SOC2 Type II report, encryption-at-rest/in-transit details, KMS integration notes). Items needing engineering input are labeled and have owners.
- PHI handling: To meet a US-only hosting commitment we'll require either Redwood Dedicated or a VPC Private deployment with customer-enforced routing. I noted the cost delta in the matrix.
- Deletion: We can implement certified-delete within 45–60 days for exported datasets; permanent deletion from backups can take longer (we documented recovery windows).

I'll be available for a 30-min sandbox walk-through if Novum's security team wants to validate the artifacts.

-Jonas
Director, Security Engineering (inference infra)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: security_evidence_matrix.csv (csv)

---
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novumhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-22T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MSA & parties for onboarding

Thanks all — this is really helpful. A few follow-ups before our legal sync:

- Novum Legal prefers Redwood to propose concrete alternate language for indemnity and the data deletion clause; can you send proposed text in-track so our counsel can react quickly?
- For residency: procurement will likely approve Dedicated if we can see a cost estimate and a short-term rollout plan. Can someone share rough delta vs hosted pricing?
- Please add your exception_log_initial.md and the party_grid_review.xlsx to the Drive folder so my procurement and engineering teams can annotate.

Let's tentatively confirm a 30-min touch on Wednesday 2027-02-23 at 09:00 PT for the legal/technical alignment. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite with Novum Legal and security.

Attachments referenced: none in this message

Best,
Ellen

On a related note — Rafael, if we land terms quickly, procurement will fast-track onboarding and may bundle a 12-month committed contract. I'll flag this in the deal record.
